detail.longDescription: Whenever I refer to intboard with intboard[#][#] , the code stops functioning. I've tried multiple ways of declaring intboard , but nothing changes. If I set a value to 0 and display it, it works fine, however if I set a value to intboard[0][0] which is equal to 0, suddenly it breaks there. This happens regardless of if the array is referenced in an if-statement, used to change a value, anything. var intboard; for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) { for (let j = 0; j < 10; j++) { intboard[i][j] = 0; } } function updataImagedata() { // Shortened for simplicity ImageData.data[0] = 0; // Works fine. ImageData.data[0] = intboard[0][0]; // Function stops, and ctx.putImageData no longer updates canvas. }
